## Document Preview

A document with its evidence provenance around it: the file rendered through the platform's own preview routing, the recorded hash, and the version chain it supersedes.

```hbs
<DocumentPreview
  @document={{@model}}
  @fileField={{@fields.file}}
  @format='embedded'
/>
```

Args: `@document` (any object with the Document shape), `@fileField` (the host's `@fields.file` component), `@format` (passed through), `@bare` (hide the provenance strip when a parent already shows it).

**It never sniffs a content type.** Passing `@fields.file` renders the file through its own format, and the file def's shell already picks the family renderer — that is the platform's File Preview Router doing the routing. Without a file field the component degrades to the realm's File Download Link, and with no file at all it says so rather than showing an empty frame: a record can legitimately exist before its artefact arrives.

`@document` is typed structurally rather than importing the Document card, because the card's isolated view renders this component and the import would close a module cycle — the same reasoning as base's `FileModelLike`.

The integrity verdict shown here is deliberately weak: a Document knows only its own recorded hash, so this reports hashed or not hashed. The tamper comparison needs two hashes and belongs to Proof Field.

## Example
The linked example is `Document/risk-score-export-fy26h2` - its isolated view is the component's real consumer, and it exercises the hash strip, the version chain and the no-file pane. **The routed-preview path is built but unexercised**: no realm file can currently be linked as a FileDef (see the Blocker of that name), so `@fileField` has nothing to render yet. That branch is one working file link away from being live, and nothing about it is conditional on the fix.

## Non-goals
Does not render a previewer of its own for any format. Does not fetch, hash or write anything. No download button — File Download Link owns that and is the fallback here.
